rules.sentence: The diagnosis of actinic keratosis is primarily made through clinical evaluation, relying on the characteristic appearance and location of the lesions.
Actinic keratosis can exhibit erratic behavior over time.
Some actinic keratoses may spontaneously regress, though the mechanisms behind this regression are not fully understood and are an area of ongoing research.[21]
On the other hand, some actinic keratoses may remain stable, showing little change in size or appearance over time.
However, it is essential to note that actinic keratoses have the potential to progress and evolve into invasive squamous cell carcinoma (SCC), a type of skin cancer.[10]
